instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. On a sandy beach with a rocky breakwater and hazy sea under an overcast sky, the woman in the peach crop top (R1) walks to the right in the left foreground, looking down and smiling happily. Beside her, the man in the blue t-shirt and headband (R2) walks to the right in the right background, laughing in profile. They walk closely side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight with a warm, muted color palette.
